faqs.a:
Notwithstanding any provision in this chapter to the contrary, a police money purchase
               plan is hereby authorized as an alternative retirement plan to the retirement plan
               established by this chapter; provided, however, that any such plan is approved by
               the members and former employees who have earned pension rights or benefits under
               this system as such approval is required by the Policemen's and Firemen's Pension
               Reform Act.
(Code 1981, § 26-3.5; Ord. No. 2227, § 6, 10-21-1985)
Editor's note—
The money purchase plan referenced in this section is not codified herein, but is
               on file in the city clerk's office.
